explanation.text:
Your product is likely NOT to meet the AfCFTA rules of origin.

Main reasons:
- One imported ingredient is in heading 19.01: Malt extract concentrate, value GHS 10,980.00. This is 18.3% of the ex-works price of GHS 60,000.00. The limit is 15%.

What to do next:
- Buy the heading 19.01 ingredient from Ghana or another AfCFTA country with proof of origin, or reduce its value to 15% of the ex-works price or less.
- You decide whether to apply. GRA Customs and the National AfCFTA Approval Committee make the official decision.
